O.location: plot title and left side of plot
O.content: The title reads "Coal vs Gas," and the left vertical label reads "Coal" in blue.
The right vertical label reads "Gas" in red.
At the x-axis tick labeled "2010," a blue circular mark is higher on the page than a red square mark.

B.text: If the blue circular series is Coal and the red square series is Gas, and their vertical positions use a common upward-increasing residential consumption/demand scale, then the series plotted higher at the same year has the larger level. Under the task instruction, route that resource to priority residential supply follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies at the 2010 x-axis checkpoint; assumes the colored axis labels bind to the correspondingly colored series and higher plot position encodes a larger value.
